name: git-forge
description: Serverless Git forge with built-in Git LFS and federated mirrors

scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test

BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN.description: Long random secret that allows exactly one call of `POST /api/bootstrap`, which creates the first instance admin and returns a personal access token. Generate it with `openssl rand -base64 32`.

INSTANCE_KEY.description: Optional. Ed25519 private JWK of this instance, needed only to mirror private repositories from other instances. Generate it with `pnpm --filter forge-worker instance-key`.

PUBLIC_URL.description: Optional. Base URL of this instance (e.g. `https://git-forge.<account>.workers.dev`); used as its federation issuer and required for scheduled mirror sync with instance tokens.
